meta.method: walk-portals.mjs nomis harvest TS074: the output-area CSV of the bulk zip, streamed; rows kept whose MSOA 2021 code is a zone code (feeds/london-datastore/zone-codes.json msoa21: an ONSPD postcode in the box carries it, 75 areas; tables without an OA file are read at the next level the zip has: LSOA, then MSOA); values as published (counts; percentages where the table has them).
